WESTBROOK STATE FORENSIC LABORATORY
Case Number: CR-2024-00871
Lab Submission No.: WSFL-2024-09918
Examiner: Dr. K. Patel, Trace Evidence Section
Report Date: April 8, 2024

ITEMS EXAMINED:
- Item 1: One folding knife, blade length 4.25 in. Submitted 03/15/2024 by Officer M. Halberg.

EXAMINATIONS REQUESTED:
- Latent print analysis on knife handle and blade.
- Touch-DNA swab of handle.

FINDINGS:
1. Latent prints: One partial latent print of value was developed on the smooth metal surface of the blade. Comparison to known prints of DANIEL R. ORTEGA: INCONCLUSIVE — insufficient ridge detail for identification or exclusion.

2. Touch-DNA: A mixed DNA profile was developed from the handle swab. Profile contains contributions from at least three (3) individuals. Major contributor consistent with reference sample of DANIEL R. ORTEGA. Minor contributors could not be deconvoluted.

CHAIN OF CUSTODY NOTE:
Lab submission form indicates Item 1 was logged into the MCPD evidence locker at 01:14, March 15, 2024. Lab intake stamp is dated 17:42, March 18, 2024. The evidence transfer log between MCPD and WSFL for the period 03/15–03/18 is missing pages 12–14, which would document the chain for this item.

End of report.
